Re-measured on the new console pin: still reproduces.

- objectstack `main` d44c8936, console built at pin `6fb31dcc9954` (QA run objectstack-ai/objectstack#25517, item `approvals.record-page-decisions` negative[1]).
- A contributor member who is not on the slate opens a project record under a pending `lockRecord: true` request: 12 inline-edit affordances, Edit enabled, no lock band. Save → `409 RECORD_LOCKED`. Reproduced on 5 fresh loads and on a second fresh-DB boot; the admin on the same record sees the lock correctly.
- `resolveApprovalLock` in `packages/react/src/context/InlineEditContext.tsx` is unchanged at `6fb31dcc`, so the fix is not in this pin.
